paper.title: AutoML-Zero: Evolving Machine Learning Algorithms From Scratch
paper.central_claim: Fine-grained evolutionary search can discover whole supervised learning algorithms from basic mathematical operations with reduced human design, rediscover backpropagation and evolve task-adapted algorithms competitive with simple neural-network baselines.

provenance.notes: 无独立收据不探测；只核作者报告。

sections_read: all102902chars: main1–5; supplementS1–S10; all65ops, raw programs, configs, tuning and ablation tables
limitations: HTML S9/S10 contain OP65 but vocabularyOP0–64; no code executed. Embedded curves not digitized.

evidence.quote:
Our goal is to show that
AutoML
can go further: it is possible today to automatically discover complete machine learning algorithms just using basic mathematical operations as building blocks.
evidence.support_explanation: 原主张：发现完整学习算法。

evidence.quote: but focus on common machine learning tasks and have dropped the self-reflexivity requirement.
evidence.support_explanation: 不要求递归自改；仍需对象审查，非单独排除理由。

evidence.quote:
The training phase alternates
Predict
and
Learn
executions.

This parent is then copied and
mutated
to produce a
child
algorithm that is added to the population, while the oldest algorithm in the population is removed.
evidence.support_explanation: 外环真实改并保存符号程序，不是只有权重变化。

evidence.quote: we treat all the constants in the algorithms as hyperparameters and jointly tune them using random search.

evidence.support_explanation: 人工解耦不是全自动迁移。

evidence.quote: We stress that the CIFAR-10 test set was used only in this final evaluation
evidence.support_explanation: 测试分隔声明，不是本席复现。

evidence.quote: using the same total compute that went into discovering and tuning the evolved algorithm.

In conclusion, even though the task used during search is simple, the results
show that our framework can discover commonly used algorithms from scratch.
evidence.support_explanation: 实际成果是监督算法而非harness。

evidence.quote:
The search method
was not the focus of this study
evidence.support_explanation: 被发现Learn不等于修改外层evolver。

assessment.strongest_supported_claim: 符号监督算法搜索真实留存/迁移程序，但没有项目agentharness对象证据；task仅定位，不否认跨数据集结果。
unresolved: 排除是对象边界，不是无非权重编辑或论文无价值。

reason: 外环持留对象虽为代码而非权重，但其用途是普通监督模型初始化/预测/权重学习；没有执行agent的非权重harness，或可直接接入其闭环的已验证组件。按项目对象边界排除，不因经典地位或自我改进词汇纳入。
rationale: 真实演化留存监督学习程序，不能误称只有权重变化；但后续用途均为模型训练分类，未建立agent harness组件闭环，范围外不评分。
